headline: How the French government is convincing banks to loan to Le Pen's campaign
description: A consortium of banks should allow far-right candidate Marine Le Pen to obtain a loan in France. In past campaigns, she took loans from Russian and Hungarian establishments after French banks were reluctant to be associated with her.
